sections.business: The synthetic company sells accelerated computing platforms.
sections.risks: Growth depends on a small group of customers and constrained advanced packaging supply.
sections.supply: Advanced packaging constraints may limit shipments despite customer demand.
sections.md&a: Management attributes growth to accelerated computing demand; capacity remains a constraint.

sections.business: The synthetic company sells cloud services and productivity software.
sections.risks: Infrastructure investment may increase depreciation and operating costs.
sections.md&a: Management attributes operating margin expansion to a shift toward higher margin cloud services and expense discipline.
sections.depreciation: Infrastructure depreciation could offset some future operating leverage.

sections.business: The synthetic company sells processors and accelerators.
sections.risks: Competition and dependence on external manufacturing may constrain growth.
sections.md&a: Management attributes revenue growth to server products, partly offset by weaker other products.

sections.business: The synthetic company sells consumer devices and related services.
sections.risks: Regulatory changes could affect services economics. Revenue depends heavily on a flagship device category.
sections.md&a: Services mix supports profitability while device demand remains uncertain.
